final: WITH rental_payments AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) as rental_total, COUNT(p.payment_id) as payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id) SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_total) as avg_total_per_rental, AVG(payment_count) as avg_payments_per_rental FROM rental_payments GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
